adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Autosomal-dominant bland progressive CKD with adolescent gout and a pathogenic UMOD variant identifies ADTKD-UMOD; the lesion is misfolded uromodulin retained in thick-ascending-limb endoplasmic reticulum.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Alport is a hematuric glomerular basement-membrane disorder; cystinosis is proximal-tubule lysosomal disease; AQP2 defects cause nephrogenic diabetes insipidus; polycystin dysfunction produces cystic disease.
